# Pinned Scorched advancement fixtures

These twelve JSON files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes

Files are beneath `building_blocks/smeltery/scorched/`, except
`scorched_soul_glass_pane.json`, which is under `decorations/smeltery/scorched/`.
`sha256.json` records the source bytes. Native adaptations change only the
recipe IDs and Horizon's recipe-unlocked predicate field.
